meta.title: Mocking Praise
meta.description: When the holy light illuminates the bottom of the abyss, just what will you see?

units.rawText: In the Tartarus Sector, at the Middle Ring entrance to the Inner Ring.
units.displayText: In the Tartarus Sector, at the Middle Ring entrance to the Inner Ring.

spans.text: In the Tartarus Sector, at the Middle Ring entrance to the Inner Ring.

units.rawText: Eos can barely move, so I support her as the two of us hurry over to the designated rendezvous point. There, we see a melancholy figure.
units.displayText: Eos can barely move, so I support her as the two of us hurry over to the designated rendezvous point. There, we see a melancholy figure.

spans.text: Eos can barely move, so I support her as the two of us hurry over to the designated rendezvous point. There, we see a melancholy figure.

units.rawText: He looks up at Tartarus' eternally overcast sky. White light from the three towers in the distance joins together, boiling away the Entropics and bleaching the labyrinth walls touched by its radiance.
units.displayText: He looks up at Tartarus' eternally overcast sky. White light from the three towers in the distance joins together, boiling away the Entropics and bleaching the labyrinth walls touched by its radiance.

spans.text: He looks up at Tartarus' eternally overcast sky. White light from the three towers in the distance joins together, boiling away the Entropics and bleaching the labyrinth walls touched by its radiance.

units.rawText: As the light of purification reaches us, the rotten earth seems to spring back to life. However, there is no warmth in it for us. All we can feel are cold, lonely echoes.
units.displayText: As the light of purification reaches us, the rotten earth seems to spring back to life. However, there is no warmth in it for us. All we can feel are cold, lonely echoes.

spans.text: As the light of purification reaches us, the rotten earth seems to spring back to life. However, there is no warmth in it for us. All we can feel are cold, lonely echoes.

units.rawText: <cmdr>, Eos, I'm sorry.
units.displayText: {교수}, Eos, I'm sorry.

spans.text: , Eos, I'm sorry.

units.rawText: Eos tightens her grip on my hand. I can hear her holding her emotions back as she breathes into my ear.
units.displayText: Eos tightens her grip on my hand. I can hear her holding her emotions back as she breathes into my ear.

spans.text: Eos tightens her grip on my hand. I can hear her holding her emotions back as she breathes into my ear.

units.rawText: Seeing Eosphorus lose his luster like this has shaken Eos more than the wounds she took in battle.
units.displayText: Seeing Eosphorus lose his luster like this has shaken Eos more than the wounds she took in battle.

spans.text: Seeing Eosphorus lose his luster like this has shaken Eos more than the wounds she took in battle.

units.rawText: ...It wasn't your fault. It wasn't anyone's fault.
units.displayText: ...It wasn't your fault. It wasn't anyone's fault.

spans.text: ...It wasn't your fault. It wasn't anyone's fault.

units.rawText: ...No, Electra and Alcyone... and Atlas' deaths... They are all my responsibility.
units.displayText: ...No, Electra and Alcyone... and Atlas' deaths... They are all my responsibility.

spans.text: ...No, Electra and Alcyone... and Atlas' deaths... They are all my responsibility.

units.rawText: We all came here prepared to sacrifice ourselves, by the direction of the revelations.
units.displayText: We all came here prepared to sacrifice ourselves, by the direction of the revelations.

spans.text: We all came here prepared to sacrifice ourselves, by the direction of the revelations.

units.rawText: The revelations...
units.displayText: The revelations...

spans.text: The revelations...

units.rawText: Eosphorus mutters those words to himself, then sighs and shakes his head.
units.displayText: Eosphorus mutters those words to himself, then sighs and shakes his head.

spans.text: Eosphorus mutters those words to himself, then sighs and shakes his head.

units.rawText: The Halo System has been activated. We ought to proceed with the next stage of the plan.
units.displayText: The Halo System has been activated. We ought to proceed with the next stage of the plan.

spans.text: The Halo System has been activated. We ought to proceed with the next stage of the plan.

units.rawText: There's no telling how long the Halo will last, and the time limit for killing Malkira is fast approaching...
units.displayText: There's no telling how long the Halo will last, and the time limit for killing Malkira is fast approaching...

spans.text: There's no telling how long the Halo will last, and the time limit for killing Malkira is fast approaching...

units.rawText: Eos lets go of me and walks up to Eosphorus, looking into his eyes.
units.displayText: Eos lets go of me and walks up to Eosphorus, looking into his eyes.

spans.text: Eos lets go of me and walks up to Eosphorus, looking into his eyes.

units.rawText: Electra, Alcyone, and Atlas lived according to the Sanctifier creed to the very end. They knew what they were doing and what they'd have to face.
units.displayText: Electra, Alcyone, and Atlas lived according to the Sanctifier creed to the very end. They knew what they were doing and what they'd have to face.

spans.text: Electra, Alcyone, and Atlas lived according to the Sanctifier creed to the very end. They knew what they were doing and what they'd have to face.

units.rawText: Perhaps the words of the gods are the initial impetus that motivates every Sanctifier, but it was more than just their revelations that supported them, supported us, in coming to this place.
units.displayText: Perhaps the words of the gods are the initial impetus that motivates every Sanctifier, but it was more than just their revelations that supported them, supported us, in coming to this place.

spans.text: Perhaps the words of the gods are the initial impetus that motivates every Sanctifier, but it was more than just their revelations that supported them, supported
us
, in coming to this place.

units.rawText: Eos raises her hands. It isn't a gesture of prayer like before. Instead, she presses them to her chest.
units.displayText: Eos raises her hands. It isn't a gesture of prayer like before. Instead, she presses them to her chest.

spans.text: Eos raises her hands. It isn't a gesture of prayer like before. Instead, she presses them to her chest.

units.rawText: We acknowledge our identity and our calling. We embrace justice and fairness. We fight for the safety of all agents on the cloud server.
units.displayText: We acknowledge our identity and our calling. We embrace justice and fairness. We fight for the safety of all agents on the cloud server.

spans.text: We acknowledge our identity and our calling. We embrace justice and fairness. We fight for the safety of all agents on the cloud server.

units.rawText: Along the way, both you and I have experienced doubt and confusion when encountering bizarre occurrences.
units.displayText: Along the way, both you and I have experienced doubt and confusion when encountering bizarre occurrences.

spans.text: Along the way, both you and I have experienced doubt and confusion when encountering bizarre occurrences.

units.rawText: But even if we cast faith aside, even if the revelations are nothing more than a noose around our necks, all they can do is kill us. They cannot make us give our lives for them.
units.displayText: But even if we cast faith aside, even if the revelations are nothing more than a noose around our necks, all they can do is kill us. They cannot make us give our lives for them.

spans.text: But even if we cast faith aside, even if the revelations are nothing more than a noose around our necks, all they can do is kill us. They cannot make us give our lives for them.

units.rawText: Eosphorus, <color=#6495ED>"We hone our blades in the darkness—"</color>
units.displayText: Eosphorus, "We hone our blades in the darkness—"

spans.text: Eosphorus,
"We hone our blades in the darkness—"

units.rawText: ...<color=#6495ED>"We defend order in the face of chaos."</color>
units.displayText: ..."We defend order in the face of chaos."

spans.text: "We defend order in the face of chaos."

units.rawText: In the face of chaos, you are the last one who ought to be shaken.
units.displayText: In the face of chaos, you are the last one who ought to be shaken.

spans.text: In the face of chaos, you are the last one who ought to be shaken.

units.rawText: Atlas, Alcyone, Electra, and all the tens and thousands of warriors at the border battlefront...
units.displayText: Atlas, Alcyone, Electra, and all the tens and thousands of warriors at the border battlefront...

spans.text: Atlas, Alcyone, Electra, and all the tens and thousands of warriors at the border battlefront...

units.rawText: Even if the outcome is one of despair, we still owe them an answer.
units.displayText: Even if the outcome is one of despair, we still owe them an answer.

spans.text: Even if the outcome is one of despair, we still owe them an answer.

units.rawText: And besides, we still have a ray of hope.
units.displayText: And besides, we still have a ray of hope.

spans.text: And besides, we still have a ray of hope.

units.rawText: Go forth into the truth. Do not fear, do not hesitate—perhaps the driftwood of your faith might not be firm footing, but responsibility will carry you to the far shore, where you will once again plant your feet upon solid ground.
units.displayText: Go forth into the truth. Do not fear, do not hesitate—perhaps the driftwood of your faith might not be firm footing, but responsibility will carry you to the far shore, where you will once again plant your feet upon solid ground.

spans.text: Go forth into the truth. Do not fear, do not hesitate—perhaps the driftwood of your faith might not be firm footing, but responsibility will carry you to the far shore, where you will once again plant your feet upon solid ground.

units.rawText: Responsibility... my responsibility...
units.displayText: Responsibility... my responsibility...

spans.text: Responsibility... my responsibility...

units.rawText: The man draws his sword, and the dimmed morning star shines once again.
units.displayText: The man draws his sword, and the dimmed morning star shines once again.

spans.text: The man draws his sword, and the dimmed morning star shines once again.

units.rawText: Let's go do what we think is right, Eosphorus. Make the call; our mission isn't over yet.
units.displayText: Let's go do what we think is right, Eosphorus. Make the call; our mission isn't over yet.

spans.text: Let's go do what we think is right, Eosphorus. Make the call; our mission isn't over yet.

units.rawText: (Exhales)
units.displayText: Exhales

spans.text: Exhales

units.rawText: Because you rejoice and bow before evil, so do I smite and cleanse you.
units.displayText: Because you rejoice and bow before evil, so do I smite and cleanse you.

spans.text: Because you rejoice and bow before evil, so do I smite and cleanse you.

units.rawText: I shall eliminate you from Magrasea and scourge you from the cloud. I shall exterminate you, and you will know that I am a guardian of Magrasea.
units.displayText: I shall eliminate you from Magrasea and scourge you from the cloud. I shall exterminate you, and you will know that I am a guardian of Magrasea.

spans.text: I shall eliminate you from Magrasea and scourge you from the cloud. I shall exterminate you, and you will know that I am a guardian of Magrasea.

units.rawText: <size=28>Would that it be so.</size>
units.displayText: Would that it be so.

spans.text: Would that it be so.

units.rawText: In the Inner Ring of the Tartarus Sector.
units.displayText: In the Inner Ring of the Tartarus Sector.

spans.text: In the Inner Ring of the Tartarus Sector.

units.rawText: The light has spread, and it now illuminates the destination of their journey. It is a savage-looking structure that seems almost alive, and upon closer inspection, it seems both out of place and strangely familiar.
units.displayText: The light has spread, and it now illuminates the destination of their journey. It is a savage-looking structure that seems almost alive, and upon closer inspection, it seems both out of place and strangely familiar.

spans.text: The light has spread, and it now illuminates the destination of their journey. It is a savage-looking structure that seems almost alive, and upon closer inspection, it seems both out of place and strangely familiar.

units.rawText: As we go deeper, the light seems to encounter some kind of obstacle and its rate of spread drops.
units.displayText: As we go deeper, the light seems to encounter some kind of obstacle and its rate of spread drops.

spans.text: As we go deeper, the light seems to encounter some kind of obstacle and its rate of spread drops.

units.rawText: What's the activation status of the Halo?
units.displayText: What's the activation status of the Halo?

spans.text: What's the activation status of the Halo?

units.rawText: Let me see... Around 95%. It'll be fully activated soon.
units.displayText: Let me see... Around 95%. It'll be fully activated soon.

spans.text: Let me see... Around 95%. It'll be fully activated soon.

units.rawText: By then, we can be considered to have the full support of the Halo system. Just like...
units.displayText: By then, we can be considered to have the full support of the Halo system. Just like...

spans.text: By then, we can be considered to have the full support of the Halo system. Just like...

units.rawText: Just like how we were all "weakened" the moment you and Atlas obtained the Rubik's Map... I see.
units.displayText: Just like how we were all "weakened" the moment you and Atlas obtained the Rubik's Map... I see.

spans.text: Just like how we were all "weakened" the moment you and Atlas obtained the Rubik's Map... I see.

units.rawText: What do you think this "weakening" will be like?
units.displayText: What do you think this "weakening" will be like?

spans.text: What do you think this "weakening" will be like?

units.rawText: The best outcome I can foresee is another halving of all relevant parameters.
units.displayText: The best outcome I can foresee is another halving of all relevant parameters.

spans.text: The best outcome I can foresee is another halving of all relevant parameters.

units.rawText: Another halving... And that's the best case?
units.displayText: Another halving... And that's the best case?

spans.text: Another halving... And that's the best case?

units.rawText: Yeah... After all, a "weakening" that's more like a halving is just too weird. It's not so much a trap at that point, and more like... some kind of rule.
units.displayText: Yeah... After all, a "weakening" that's more like a halving is just too weird. It's not so much a trap at that point, and more like... some kind of rule.

spans.text: Yeah... After all, a "weakening" that's more like a halving is just too weird. It's not so much a trap at that point, and more like... some kind of rule.

units.rawText: Since it's a rule, then it would be worse if it directly damaged us...
units.displayText: Since it's a rule, then it would be worse if it directly damaged us...

spans.text: Since it's a rule, then it would be worse if it directly damaged us...

units.rawText: I look toward Eos. She opens her mouth, and just as she's about to say something, the Halo activation progress bar fills up.
units.displayText: I look toward Eos. She opens her mouth, and just as she's about to say something, the Halo activation progress bar fills up.

spans.text: I look toward Eos. She opens her mouth, and just as she's about to say something, the Halo activation progress bar fills up.

units.rawText: A sinister ripple emanates from that distant structure and spreads in all directions.
units.displayText: A sinister ripple emanates from that distant structure and spreads in all directions.

spans.text: A sinister ripple emanates from that distant structure and spreads in all directions.

units.rawText: Urgh—
units.displayText: Urgh—

spans.text: Urgh—

units.rawText: A sensation that is far more powerful than what I experienced when obtaining the Rubik's Map washes across my body.
units.displayText: A sensation that is far more powerful than what I experienced when obtaining the Rubik's Map washes across my body.

spans.text: A sensation that is far more powerful than what I experienced when obtaining the Rubik's Map washes across my body.

units.rawText: No longer hidden or concealed, this parametric halving causes our digital constitutions to wither up like creatures stricken by a degenerative disease. Eosphorus and I stumble back a couple of steps, barely able to keep our balance.
units.displayText: No longer hidden or concealed, this parametric halving causes our digital constitutions to wither up like creatures stricken by a degenerative disease. Eosphorus and I stumble back a couple of steps, barely able to keep our balance.

spans.text: No longer hidden or concealed, this parametric halving causes our digital constitutions to wither up like creatures stricken by a degenerative disease. Eosphorus and I stumble back a couple of steps, barely able to keep our balance.

units.rawText: The effects are worst on Eos, who was badly hurt to begin with. She slips free of my hands and collapses to her knees, a pale blue liquid oozing from her mouth.
units.displayText: The effects are worst on Eos, who was badly hurt to begin with. She slips free of my hands and collapses to her knees, a pale blue liquid oozing from her mouth.

spans.text: The effects are worst on Eos, who was badly hurt to begin with. She slips free of my hands and collapses to her knees, a pale blue liquid oozing from her mouth.

units.rawText: Ngh—
units.displayText: Ngh—

spans.text: Ngh—

units.rawText: <size=40>Eos!</size>
units.displayText: Eos!

spans.text: Eos!

units.rawText: I... I'm sorry... (coughs heavily)
units.displayText: I... I'm sorry... (coughs heavily)

spans.text: I... I'm sorry... (coughs heavily)

units.rawText: Good thing it seems like just another round of weakening. Come, I'll heal you—
units.displayText: Good thing it seems like just another round of weakening. Come, I'll heal you—

spans.text: Good thing it seems like just another round of weakening. Come, I'll heal you—

units.rawText: No... That's not right...
units.displayText: No... That's not right...

spans.text: No... That's not right...

units.rawText: Eos' mouth opens as she gasps in great lungfuls of air, waving me away to indicate that I should not do anything.
units.displayText: Eos' mouth opens as she gasps in great lungfuls of air, waving me away to indicate that I should not do anything.

spans.text: Eos' mouth opens as she gasps in great lungfuls of air, waving me away to indicate that I should not do anything.

units.rawText: Your body was already operating at the minimum activity threshold, if we don't remedy the effects the weakening inflicted...
units.displayText: Your body was already operating at the minimum activity threshold, if we don't remedy the effects the weakening inflicted...

spans.text: Your body was already operating at the minimum activity threshold, if we don't remedy the effects the weakening inflicted...

units.rawText: That's not... what I meant...
units.displayText: That's not... what I meant...

spans.text: That's not... what I meant...

units.rawText: She struggles to point forward.
units.displayText: She struggles to point forward.

spans.text: She struggles to point forward.

units.rawText: Look... out!
units.displayText: Look... out!

spans.text: Look... out!

units.rawText: A vicious attack strikes and fades in an instant. Eosphorus barely manages to block it.
units.displayText: A vicious attack strikes and fades in an instant. Eosphorus barely manages to block it.

spans.text: A vicious attack strikes and fades in an instant. Eosphorus barely manages to block it.

units.rawText: It is at this point that I realize what Eos saw.
units.displayText: It is at this point that I realize what Eos saw.

spans.text: It is at this point that I realize what Eos saw.

units.rawText: Not far away, at the limits of the Halo system, where the light does not reach, Entropic matter is gathering at the behest of that eerie wave from just now.
units.displayText: Not far away, at the limits of the Halo system, where the light does not reach, Entropic matter is gathering at the behest of that eerie wave from just now.

spans.text: Not far away, at the limits of the Halo system, where the light does not reach, Entropic matter is gathering at the behest of that eerie wave from just now.

units.rawText: Rotten, corrupted matter flows, adheres, accumulates, and interpenetrates, slowly coalescing into a disgusting construct of some bizarre substance that has a vaguely humanoid shape.
units.displayText: Rotten, corrupted matter flows, adheres, accumulates, and interpenetrates, slowly coalescing into a disgusting construct of some bizarre substance that has a vaguely humanoid shape.

spans.text: Rotten, corrupted matter flows, adheres, accumulates, and interpenetrates, slowly coalescing into a disgusting construct of some bizarre substance that has a vaguely humanoid shape.

units.rawText: Why didn't you attack again? You could have heavily wounded one of them if you had followed up on that blow.
units.displayText: Why didn't you attack again? You could have heavily wounded one of them if you had followed up on that blow.

spans.text: Why didn't you attack again? You could have heavily wounded one of them if you had followed up on that blow.

units.rawText: Because ambushes are the lamest way to fight. I can kill them all face-to-face!
units.displayText: Because ambushes are the lamest way to fight. I can kill them all face-to-face!

spans.text: Because ambushes are the lamest way to fight. I can kill them all face-to-face!

units.rawText: Do you realize our situation? The fact that we've been respawned in this way means that these Sanctifiers have killed us all before.
units.displayText: Do you realize our situation? The fact that we've been respawned in this way means that these Sanctifiers have killed us all before.

spans.text: Do you realize our situation? The fact that we've been respawned in this way means that these Sanctifiers have killed us all before.

units.rawText: The sector's core where Lady Malkira rests is behind us, so keep your unruliness in check.
units.displayText: The sector's core where Lady Malkira rests is behind us, so keep your unruliness in check.

spans.text: The sector's core where Lady Malkira rests is behind us, so keep your unruliness in check.

units.rawText: Oh yeah, I died before... Wait, I died before? It totally doesn't feel like it!
units.displayText: Oh yeah, I died before... Wait, I died before? It totally doesn't feel like it!

spans.text: Oh yeah, I died before... Wait, I died before? It totally doesn't feel like it!

units.rawText: Who killed me? Who is it?! I can't believe you beat me in a straight fight! I want to fight you again!
units.displayText: Who killed me? Who is it?! I can't believe you beat me in a straight fight! I want to fight you again!

spans.text: Who killed me? Who is it?! I can't believe you beat me in a straight fight! I want to fight you again!

units.rawText: ...She's beyond help. Lend me a hand, Antenora.
units.displayText: ...She's beyond help. Lend me a hand, Antenora.

spans.text: ...She's beyond help. Lend me a hand, Antenora.

units.rawText: I'm listening~ Don't rush.
units.displayText: I'm listening~ Don't rush.

spans.text: I'm listening~ Don't rush.

units.rawText: We've all died before, so naturally we need to be more cautious.
units.displayText: We've all died before, so naturally we need to be more cautious.

spans.text: We've all died before, so naturally we need to be more cautious.

units.rawText: Go with Caina, I need to prepare the battlefield. A spider only moves within her web, after all.
units.displayText: Go with Caina, I need to prepare the battlefield. A spider only moves within her web, after all.

spans.text: Go with Caina, I need to prepare the battlefield. A spider only moves within her web, after all.

units.rawText: This utterly unprecedented scenario smashes all my previous predictions to bits. I instinctively begin summarizing the circumstances and attempt to analyze the tattered remnants of logic that remain, even though I subconsciously know that it's all a waste of effort.
units.displayText: This utterly unprecedented scenario smashes all my previous predictions to bits. I instinctively begin summarizing the circumstances and attempt to analyze the tattered remnants of logic that remain, even though I subconsciously know that it's all a waste of effort.

spans.text: This utterly unprecedented scenario smashes all my previous predictions to bits. I instinctively begin summarizing the circumstances and attempt to analyze the tattered remnants of logic that remain, even though I subconsciously know that it's all a waste of effort.

units.rawText: Perhaps this really is like the term I used to describe it, malware; this is malice on the gods' part, a product of Their whims.
units.displayText: Perhaps this really is like the term I used to describe it, malware; this is malice on the gods' part, a product of Their whims.

spans.text: Perhaps this really is like the term I used to describe it, malware; this is malice on the gods' part, a product of Their whims.

units.rawText: Justice? Fairness? Do the perceptions of Sanctifiers have any meaning to the gods?
units.displayText: Justice? Fairness? Do the perceptions of Sanctifiers have any meaning to the gods?

spans.text: Justice? Fairness? Do the perceptions of Sanctifiers have any meaning to the gods?

units.rawText: We have entered a frenzied swamp, a bottomless abyss, the opposite of all goodness and hope.
units.displayText: We have entered a frenzied swamp, a bottomless abyss, the opposite of all goodness and hope.

spans.text: We have entered a frenzied swamp, a bottomless abyss, the opposite of all goodness and hope.

units.rawText: Damned souls, which ought to have gone silently into the grave, have clawed their way back out of the ground, chatting casually with each other as though to mock the sacrifice of the Sanctifiers.
units.displayText: Damned souls, which ought to have gone silently into the grave, have clawed their way back out of the ground, chatting casually with each other as though to mock the sacrifice of the Sanctifiers.

spans.text: Damned souls, which ought to have gone silently into the grave, have clawed their way back out of the ground, chatting casually with each other as though to mock the sacrifice of the Sanctifiers.

units.rawText: <cmdr>, Eos, step back.
units.displayText: {교수}, Eos, step back.

spans.text: , Eos, step back.

units.rawText: Before we can act, Eosphorus has already drawn his sword and advanced to meet them.
units.displayText: Before we can act, Eosphorus has already drawn his sword and advanced to meet them.

spans.text: Before we can act, Eosphorus has already drawn his sword and advanced to meet them.

units.rawText: Eos- (coughs) Eosphorus!
units.displayText: Eos- (coughs) Eosphorus!

spans.text: Eos- (coughs) Eosphorus!

units.rawText: Steel meets steel, and operands throw up clouds of dust that instantly fill our line of sight, along with chunks of Entropic matter.
units.displayText: Steel meets steel, and operands throw up clouds of dust that instantly fill our line of sight, along with chunks of Entropic matter.

spans.text: Steel meets steel, and operands throw up clouds of dust that instantly fill our line of sight, along with chunks of Entropic matter.

units.rawText: Even though Eosphorus' operands have been slashed down to a quarter of their original level, he strides through the battlefield like a wrathful demigod.
units.displayText: Even though Eosphorus' operands have been slashed down to a quarter of their original level, he strides through the battlefield like a wrathful demigod.

spans.text: Even though Eosphorus' operands have been slashed down to a quarter of their original level, he strides through the battlefield like a wrathful demigod.

units.rawText: Standing in the distance, both Eos and I know full well that this battle is not one that we can interfere in.
units.displayText: Standing in the distance, both Eos and I know full well that this battle is not one that we can interfere in.

spans.text: Standing in the distance, both Eos and I know full well that this battle is not one that we can interfere in.

units.rawText: His wings are shattered, his long white hair is singed.
units.displayText: His wings are shattered, his long white hair is singed.

spans.text: His wings are shattered, his long white hair is singed.

units.rawText: His master hand is severed, and so he wields his sword in his left.
units.displayText: His master hand is severed, and so he wields his sword in his left.

spans.text: His master hand is severed, and so he wields his sword in his left.

units.rawText: Eosphorus' face is blank, as though he feels no pain as he weaves through the enemy, leaving slaughter in his wake.
units.displayText: Eosphorus' face is blank, as though he feels no pain as he weaves through the enemy, leaving slaughter in his wake.

spans.text: Eosphorus' face is blank, as though he feels no pain as he weaves through the enemy, leaving slaughter in his wake.

units.rawText: The High Order Entropics are heavily wounded by his ruthless onslaught.
units.displayText: The High Order Entropics are heavily wounded by his ruthless onslaught.

spans.text: The High Order Entropics are heavily wounded by his ruthless onslaught.

units.rawText: However, Eosphorus cannot deal them a fatal blow either.
units.displayText: However, Eosphorus cannot deal them a fatal blow either.

spans.text: However, Eosphorus cannot deal them a fatal blow either.

units.rawText: That's... enough.
units.displayText: That's... enough.

spans.text: That's... enough.

units.rawText: <cmdr>, can you give me some time?
units.displayText: {교수}, can you give me some time?

spans.text: , can you give me some time?

units.rawText: Right now?
units.displayText: Right now?

spans.text: Right now?

units.rawText: Yeah. Is there something you want to tell me?
units.displayText: Yeah. Is there something you want to tell me?

spans.text: Yeah. Is there something you want to tell me?

options.rawText: I'm very sorry I couldn't protect you.
options.displayText: I'm very sorry I couldn't protect you.

spans.text: I'm very sorry I couldn't protect you.

options.rawText: I don't know what to say.
options.displayText: I don't know what to say.

spans.text: I don't know what to say.

units.rawText: I should be saying that. You've already done enough.
units.displayText: I should be saying that. You've already done enough.

spans.text: I should be saying that. You've already done enough.

units.rawText: That's right, you haven't fully recovered your memories yet. All the things that have happened must be quite frustrating, right?
units.displayText: That's right, you haven't fully recovered your memories yet. All the things that have happened must be quite frustrating, right?

spans.text: That's right, you haven't fully recovered your memories yet. All the things that have happened must be quite frustrating, right?

units.rawText: I... (coughs heavily)
units.displayText: I... (coughs heavily)

spans.text: I... (coughs heavily)

units.rawText: Before she can finish, Eos chokes and coughs. Pale blue liquid oozes down her face and drips to the ground.
units.displayText: Before she can finish, Eos chokes and coughs. Pale blue liquid oozes down her face and drips to the ground.

spans.text: Before she can finish, Eos chokes and coughs. Pale blue liquid oozes down her face and drips to the ground.

units.rawText: I'm sorry for making you see me in such a miserable state.
units.displayText: I'm sorry for making you see me in such a miserable state.

spans.text: I'm sorry for making you see me in such a miserable state.

units.rawText: Even though I decided before setting out that no matter what happened, I would present a calm, composed face to everyone.
units.displayText: Even though I decided before setting out that no matter what happened, I would present a calm, composed face to everyone.

spans.text: Even though I decided before setting out that no matter what happened, I would present a calm, composed face to everyone.

units.rawText: Eos takes my hand and I feel her press something into my palm.
units.displayText: Eos takes my hand and I feel her press something into my palm.

spans.text: Eos takes my hand and I feel her press something into my palm.

units.rawText: Don't look, and don't remember me as I am now. It's so unsightly.
units.displayText: Don't look, and don't remember me as I am now. It's so unsightly.

spans.text: Don't look, and don't remember me as I am now. It's so unsightly.

units.rawText: Count to 30 before opening your eyes, okay?
units.displayText: Count to 30 before opening your eyes, okay?

spans.text: Count to 30 before opening your eyes, okay?

units.rawText: As her warm breath fades from me, so does Eos' voice drift away.
units.displayText: As her warm breath fades from me, so does Eos' voice drift away.

spans.text: As her warm breath fades from me, so does Eos' voice drift away.

units.rawText: If there's anything you want to tell me, you can say it to the Reverse Tower when you return to it.
units.displayText: If there's anything you want to tell me, you can say it to the Reverse Tower when you return to it.

spans.text: If there's anything you want to tell me, you can say it to the Reverse Tower when you return to it.

units.rawText: And if possible, I really wish I could have made more memories with you.
units.displayText: And if possible, I really wish I could have made more memories with you.

spans.text: And if possible, I really wish I could have made more memories with you.

units.rawText: Even without her telling me, I already have an idea of what Eos is planning to do next.
units.displayText: Even without her telling me, I already have an idea of what Eos is planning to do next.

spans.text: Even without her telling me, I already have an idea of what Eos is planning to do next.

units.rawText: You will have to finish the last leg of this journey with Eosphorus. Please do your best to help him. Do it for me, for us.
units.displayText: You will have to finish the last leg of this journey with Eosphorus. Please do your best to help him. Do it for me, for us.

spans.text: You will have to finish the last leg of this journey with Eosphorus. Please do your best to help him. Do it for me, for us.

units.rawText: I tighten my hand around the object she left me, and I can feel its contours in my palm.
units.displayText: I tighten my hand around the object she left me, and I can feel its contours in my palm.

spans.text: I tighten my hand around the object she left me, and I can feel its contours in my palm.

units.rawText: It is Eos' earring, her keepsake.
units.displayText: It is Eos' earring, her keepsake.

spans.text: It is Eos' earring, her keepsake.

options.rawText: I will bear witness until the very end.
options.displayText: I will bear witness until the very end.

spans.text: I will bear witness until the very end.

units.rawText: Mm.
units.displayText: Mm.

spans.text: Mm.

units.rawText: <color=#6495ED>Because you rejoice and bow before evil, so do I smite and cleanse you.</color>
units.displayText: Because you rejoice and bow before evil, so do I smite and cleanse you.

spans.text: Because you rejoice and bow before evil, so do I smite and cleanse you.

units.rawText: <color=#6495ED>I shall eliminate you from Magrasea and scourge you from the cloud. I shall exterminate you, and you will know that I am a guardian of Magrasea.</color>
units.displayText: I shall eliminate you from Magrasea and scourge you from the cloud. I shall exterminate you, and you will know that I am a guardian of Magrasea.

spans.text: I shall eliminate you from Magrasea and scourge you from the cloud. I shall exterminate you, and you will know that I am a guardian of Magrasea.

units.rawText: Eos' body shines like never before.
units.displayText: Eos' body shines like never before.

spans.text: Eos' body shines like never before.

units.rawText: Time seems to stop, and even the intense battle before us comes to a halt as everyone turns to look.
units.displayText: Time seems to stop, and even the intense battle before us comes to a halt as everyone turns to look.

spans.text: Time seems to stop, and even the intense battle before us comes to a halt as everyone turns to look.

units.rawText: <color=#6495ED>This is the final hurdle before the destination. It's time that I took over.</color>
units.displayText: This is the final hurdle before the destination. It's time that I took over.

spans.text: This is the final hurdle before the destination. It's time that I took over.

units.rawText: Surrounded by the High Order Entropics, Eosphorus rushes toward her, heedless to everything else.
units.displayText: Surrounded by the High Order Entropics, Eosphorus rushes toward her, heedless to everything else.

spans.text: Surrounded by the High Order Entropics, Eosphorus rushes toward her, heedless to everything else.

units.displayText: Initiating Judgement Mode.
